literal: Good path even if, receiving is bad; higher world does not exist even if, giving alone is good.
translation: Even if receiving is considered a good path, it is bad. Even if there is no higher world, giving alone is good.
modern: பிறரிடம் இருந்து பொருளைப் பெறுவது நல்ல வழி என்று சொல்லப்பட்டாலும் அது தீமையானது. மேலுலகம் இல்லை என்று சொல்லப்பட்டாலும் பிறருக்குக் கொடுப்பதே நன்மையானது.
explanation: This couplet contrasts the inherent nature of receiving and giving. The word 'நல்லாறு' (good path) suggests that even if taking from others is justified as a righteous or acceptable way to live, it remains inherently bad. Conversely, even if one believes there is no 'மேலுலகம்' (higher world or heaven) to reward good deeds, the act of giving is still inherently good. The emphasis marker 'ஏ' in 'ஈதலே' stresses that giving is an absolute virtue, independent of any expectation of future rewards.
